[EN] The battle for Darkquaver Woods is more than just faeries and foliage.

We must always remind ourselves that if Thulsa wants something here, it's important that we thwart him!
[ES] La batalla por Darkquaver Woods es más que solo hadas y follaje.

¡Siempre debemos recordar que si Thulsa quiere algo aquí, es importante que lo frustremos!
